Adrian brings experience across fintech, proptech, edutech and sports analytics, working with enterprises including Goldman Sachs and Telepass, as well as Series A startups.
His work on open-source generative model performance has been featured at NVIDIA’s GTC. As co-founder and president of Málaga AI, he helps make AI knowledge more accessible.
